title: Check if a value is empty
description: Write a function `is_empty(value)` that returns whether `value` (a string, list, tuple, dict, or set) has no elements.
hints: len() works the same way across strings, lists, tuples, dicts, and sets - it always answers 'how many elements does this hold', and 0 elements means empty.
expected_behavior: Returns True if value has zero elements, False otherwise.
explanation: len() is a single interface that works the same way across every built-in container type, so is_empty doesn't need a separate check per type.
